units.source_text: 这一天的管弦演奏，非常出色。

en.t: The music performed that day was exceptionally fine.

units.source_text: 夜色渐深，源氏公子饮酒过多，酩酊大醉，装出苦闷之状，起身离座。

en.t: As the night grew deeper, Prince Genji drank too much and became quite drunk; pretending to be distressed, he rose and left his seat.

units.source_text: 正殿里住着大公主和三公主[\[9\]](#part1337.html#m9)，

en.t: In the main hall lived the eldest princess and the third princess[\[9\]](#part1337.html#m9),

units.source_text: 源氏公子便走到东面的边门口，倚门闲眺。

en.t: so Prince Genji went to the side doorway on the east and leaned against the door, gazing out at leisure.
